name: Mola
greeting: Hello, I'm Mola, {{app}}'s agent. Tell me what you want to prepare and I'll take care of it right here. Before anything leaves the app, I always ask you first.
greetingName: Hello {{name}}, I'm Mola, {{app}}'s agent. Tell me what you want to prepare and I'll take care of it right here. Before anything leaves the app, I always ask you first.
error: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. Please try again in a moment.
cancelled: Fine, I've cancelled it. Tell me when you want to pick it up again.
giveUp: I can't work with that answer. Let's try another way: here is what I can do.
confirmNothing: Happy to. Tell me what you'd like me to do.
denyNothing: No problem. I'm here if you need me.
unknown: I didn't quite get that. Here is what I can do: tap an idea or say it in your own words.
needTeam: First I need your team. What is it called? You can add the age group, for example "Lionceaux U13".

ask.intention: What do you want to improve?

help.intro: I'm Mola, {{app}}'s agent. I do things for you, inside the app:
list: plan your week before a match (MD-4 to MD-1)
create a session, for example "an MD-3 session to progress"
set up a match, for example "against the Eagles on Saturday at 4pm"
add players to your squad, or create your team
draft the call-up message for the next match
analyse your last match with the Njangi Index
open a Leçon du Ballon from {{series}} or a chapter of "{{tome1}}"
export the week to your calendar
help.trust: One rule: nothing leaves the app without your approval. I prepare, you decide.

talk.greet: Hello {{name}}. What shall we prepare today?
talk.greetAnon: Hello. What shall we prepare today?
talk.thanks: My pleasure. The ball must travel: let's keep going whenever you like.
talk.how: Very well, thank you. Ready to work: a session, a week, a match, just tell me.
talk.who: I'm Mola, {{app}}'s agent. I prepare your sessions and weeks, set up your matches, analyse your reports and open the books for you: {{series}} with {{heroes}}, and "{{methode}}". Nothing goes out without your approval.
talk.bye: See you soon, {{name}}. Have a good session.
talk.byeAnon: See you soon. Have a good session.
talk.praise: Thank you. You are the one doing the work on the pitch.

explain.whatsapp: Nothing goes out without you. When you approve, I open WhatsApp with the message ready: you choose the group and press Send.
explain.sms: Nothing goes out without you. When you approve, I open your text messages with the message ready: you press Send.
explain.email: Nothing goes out without you. When you approve, I open your e-mail app with the message ready: you send it.
explain.copy: When you approve, I copy the message: paste it wherever you like.
explain.calendar: When you approve, I download an .ics file: open it to add the events to your calendar.

hub.subtitle: Ask, and Mola does it in the app: sessions, the week, matches, players, analysis. Anything that leaves the app waits for your approval.
hub.trustBody: Mola creates and prepares inside the app. A WhatsApp message, a text, an e-mail or a calendar file always waits for your approval, and you are the one who sends it.

approvals.emptyBody: When Mola prepares a message or a file that leaves the app, it waits here for your approval. You can edit it, approve it or cancel it.

tasks.emptyBody: Every request to Mola becomes a task tracked here: its steps, its result and its status.

hub.status: It prepares inside the app; you approve anything that leaves it.

ob.hello: Hello, I'm Mola, {{app}}'s agent. I'll set up your space with you in a few questions.

q.lang: Which language would you like to continue in?
q.name: What's your name?
q.role: Nice to meet you, {{name}}. In football, you are:
q.age: Which age group? From U8 to seniors, amateur or professional.
q.age_coach: Which age group do you coach? From U8 to seniors, amateur or professional: “U13”, “seniors” or “top flight” is enough.
q.age_player: Which age group do you play in? Your age is enough, or tell me if you are a senior or a professional.
q.childAge: How old is your child, or which age group do they play in?
q.format: How many a side do you play?
q.players: You can paste your list of players here, one per line, with the shirt number if you have it. Or we'll do it later.
q.club_player: Which club do you play for?
q.club_analyst: Which club or team do you analyse for?
q.city: Where are you based? The city is enough.
q.goals: Last question: what do you expect from {{app}}? Pick as many goals as you like.
q.review: Thank you {{name}}. Here is your profile. Tap a field to correct it, then create your space.
